title: UP Election 2022 Voter Slip Download
postName: Voter Information Slip / Polling Booth Details – UP Assembly Election 2022
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://voters.eci.gov.in or CEO UP portal
2. Search name in electoral roll by EPIC / details
3. Check polling station
4. Download voter information / slip if available
5. Carry original EPIC on polling day
shortDescription: UP Election 2022 Voter Slip Download – find booth and download voter info from ECI / CEO UP portals.
content:
During Uttar Pradesh Assembly Election 2022, voters could search their names and download voter information slips / know their polling booth online.

Services remain available on voters.eci.gov.in for electoral roll search and e-EPIC.
